lines.q: Thirty-five Halloween questions. If you get thirty right, you're a true Halloween expert. Halloween is on which date in October?
lines.a: October thirty-first! The night before All Saints' Day.

lines.q: What do most people carve at Halloween?
Which colour cat is said to bring bad luck?
lines.a: Black! Though in Britain, they're often lucky.

lines.q: Which monster drinks blood?
Who wrote the novel Frankenstein?
lines.a: Mary Shelley! She was only a teenager when she began it.

lines.q: Which creature changes shape at the full moon?
What do children say at the door on Halloween?
Which mammal can truly fly?
lines.a: The bat! The others only glide.

lines.q: Halloween grew out of which ancient Celtic festival?
The jack-o'-lantern is named after which Irish legend?
lines.a: Stingy Jack! He tricked the devil.

lines.q: In the novel, Count Dracula's castle is in which region?
Who wrote the novel Dracula, published in eighteen ninety-seven?
Who played Dracula in the famous nineteen thirty-one film?
A group of crows is called a what?
Which nineteen sixty Hitchcock film has a famous shower scene?
Which ghost haunts Sleepy Hollow?
Which pharaoh's tomb was discovered in nineteen twenty-two?
Michael Jackson's Thriller album came out in which year?
lines.a: Nineteen eighty-two! If you're enjoying this, subscribe and turn on the bell!

lines.q: Whose voice does the spooky rap in Thriller?
What does the word Halloween come from?
lines.a: All Hallows' Eve! The evening before All Saints' Day.

lines.q: Who played the monster in Frankenstein, nineteen thirty-one?
Where were the famous witch trials of sixteen ninety-two?
Who wrote the poem The Raven?
Which famous escape artist died on Halloween, nineteen twenty-six?
Who is the masked killer in the film Halloween from nineteen seventy-eight?
Vampire bats live naturally in which part of the world?
Mary Shelley dreamed up Frankenstein beside which lake?
lines.a: Lake Geneva! In the stormy summer of eighteen sixteen.

lines.q: When was Frankenstein first published?
The real Vlad the Impaler ruled which land?
Which US state grows the most pumpkins?
Who directed Night of the Living Dead in nineteen sixty-eight?
In the Peanuts special, who waits all night for the Great Pumpkin?
The phrase trick or treat first appeared in print in which decade?
lines.a: The nineteen twenties! In Canada, not the USA.

lines.q: Orson Welles' War of the Worlds radio show caused panic around Halloween in which year?
Final question. Dracula's author, Bram Stoker, was born in which country?

outroLine: How many did you get? Comment your score below, and subscribe with the bell on for a new quiz every day!
